result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete an edge from the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1629-L1733){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_edge( source=None, target=None, id=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Delete edge](/assets/graphs/delete-edge.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Before: a four-node cycle with the edge between A and C highlighted in the accent color. After: that edge is gone, shown dashed, while all four nodes and the other three edges stay in place." width="100%"} Remove edges by specifying either the source and target nodes, or the edge ID directly. For multigraphs with source/target, only the first matching edge is deleted. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str, None]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Source node ID or label. Required if `id=` is not provided. [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str, None]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Target node ID or label. Required if `id=` is not provided. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Edge ID to delete. If provided, `source=` and `target=` are ignored. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If no edge exists matching the criteria. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If neither (`source`, `target`) nor `id` is provided. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Providing both `source` and `target` deletes the first matching edge between them: ::: {#db9b5098 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .delete_edge(source="A", target="B") ) graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` False ``` ::: ::: When the edge ID is already known, deleting by `id=` skips the source/target lookup entirely: ::: {#2752b44b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) edge_id = graph.get_edge_ids()[0] graph.delete_edge(id=edge_id) graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: :::
